name: Wide Residual Stream
replaces: FFN-width residual stopped and reverted at the user's request; do not resume7815469.0
backbone: Ordinary full-attention vanilla, original ReLU-squared MLP. SwiGLU in the prompt is illustrative per earlier correction.
normalization_confirmation: User explicitly selected normalization only over the wide state; no extra d-dimensional pre-norm after down_proj.
sublayer_read: x = down_proj(RMSNorm(S)); parameter-free RMSNorm over the complete4d dimension
sublayer_compute: Original attention(x), retaining RoPE and QK norm; or original c_proj(relu(c_fc(x))**2). No inner identity residual.
sublayer_write: S = S + up_proj(y), coefficient1, wide identity path preserved
readout: h = RMSNorm(final_down_proj(S)), then the original d->vocab head and softcap15
projections: Each attention and MLP has separate bias-free dense4d->d and d->4d matrices. Initial and final projections are independent. No low-rank factorization, gating or tied projections.
initialization: New matrices uniform±sqrt(3/fan_in), nonzero. Original backbone weights/RNG and original zero attention-output/MLP-down initialization preserved. No runtime scaling or constraints.
rank_note: Dense rectangular parameterization has maximal rank d at random initialization; no rank constraint is imposed during training.
optimizer: Original MuonAdamW, all new projection matrices use existing Muon groups/LR/WD; original defaults and schedule unchanged

gate.data: Existing packed2K small prefix; no W&B, credentials or returned weights
gate.profile: Same GPU baseline/new each20warmup+40timed full-size updates; unchanged B16/accum1/no checkpointing, fixed22GB allocation budget
gate.restart: 25->exit85->new process50, full305176-step LR horizon; exact optimizer/RNG tested separately with fixed gradients

training.authorization: Replace the rejected run with the new architecture while keeping all other training configurations unchanged
training.monitor: Only until first finite formal training step, then exit

limitations: This increases parameters and compute, unlike small mHC stream mixing. No quality or efficiency advantage is presumed. Short validation does not guarantee long-run stability. Native and mHC implementations are preserved; combining them with this option is explicitly rejected.
